_source: King Crab Grades Your Midterm. Build from the jumper checkout: python scripts/deploy.py --manifests <this file> --manifest king_crab_grader --allow-incomplete. Every policy is a shipped export of KingKongRobotics/jumper (tasks/<task>/out/example); nothing here is trained.

king_crab_grader.description: King Crab the professor: jumper.posture walks (the crab-walk sideways and the body's pitch and twist, used for the head shake), jumper.five_foot carries the right claw that picks up and reads a midterm (RB, or B), and jumper.dance is the victory dance for an A+ (Menu + up, or Ctrl + 1). Menu (Ctrl) let go on its own leaves the dance.

locomotion._note: Walking (left stick; crab-walk is the stick's x) and the body's posture (right stick: pitch, and twist for the slow head shake). Reached by the cascade's `always` rule.

claw_right._note: Five-foot walking with the right front arm carried as the claw (the mirror hook). RT closes the claw as far as it is held; the d-pad holds the arm out at a preset; the right stick's pitch tilts the body up to read.

dance_crab._note: The crab dance, as the A+ victory dance. Starts on entry, ends by itself, and the cascade hands back to locomotion.

king_crab_grader_alt_F.description: King Crab Grades Your Midterm, the F cut: jumper.posture walks (the crab-walk sideways and the body's pitch and twist, used for the head shake) and jumper.five_foot carries the right claw that picks up, reads and puts down the midterm (RB, or B). No dance: this cut ends on the F.

locomotion._note: Walking (left stick; crab-walk is the stick's x) and the body's posture (right stick: pitch, and twist for the slow head shake). Reached by the cascade's `always` rule.

claw_right._note: Five-foot walking with the right front arm carried as the claw (the mirror hook). RT closes the claw as far as it is held; the d-pad holds the arm out at a preset; the right stick's pitch tilts the body up to read.
